resources.string: Hōʻike i ke kūlana holo o ke kikowaena a me nā mana
Kope ʻia ʻo IP i ka papa ʻokiʻoki
E hoʻopau mau kēia i ka honua. He ʻoiaʻiʻo kēnā?
\'Ōlelo Aʻo: Ua wela loa ka mea hana - e noʻonoʻo e hoʻōki i ke kikowaena
\'Ōlelo Aʻo: ʻIke ʻia ka RAM haʻahaʻa - hiki ke hoʻohaʻahaʻa ʻia ka hana

ʻAʻole manuahi ʻo PocketCraft no nā mea a pau, akā aia kekahi mau hiʻohiʻona i Pro i hiki iā ʻoe ke kākoʻo i kā mākou kikowaena koina a me nā koina holo polokalamu. He ʻuʻuku lākou, a ʻo ia ke kumu i loaʻa ai lākou i laila, me kēlā no ka waiwai ʻoi aku.
Inā makemake ʻoe e kōkua iā mākou, a makemake paha e kamaʻilio me ka hui, e hui pū me kā mākou Discord — makemake mākou e loaʻa iā ʻoe.
